app.notes:
Video karaoke: put karaoke videos (MP4, MKV, WebM) in your songs folder and each one gets a song code, marked MTV
MTV songs play on the stage with their own picture, and key, tempo, the microphone, recording, and scoring all work
A MIDI or LRC file with the same name as a video adds lyrics, and a MIDI also gives the melody for pitch scoring
Videos without a melody are scored on how much of the song you sang and how steadily you held the notes
New Stage Text settings: write your own words in place of "Select a Song" and add a greeting line, in your own font and colour
A brand-new look from the home page to Settings, with a 3D microphone made for every theme
A bar along the bottom, or down the side on a TV, takes you to Home, Songs, My Songs, Profile, and Settings in one tap
A redesigned keypad with easier Key, Tempo, and Melody controls and a big Play button
Tapping a song in the stage search now asks whether to sing it now or reserve it, and reserving no longer starts it
Every song list has a Sing button, and the top three scores now stand on a podium
Settings are grouped into categories, and the search still finds any setting
Mic-Key now runs full screen. Turn it off in Settings, Behavior, Full Screen
VIP is free for everyone: send your Device ID to get a code. Donating is optional
